reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Maryland
    Focus year: 2021

    NOTE: The provided "statutes" are not housing/landlord-tenant eviction statutes.
    They concern (1) State payroll authorization and recovery of improper payments, and
    (2) a public service company franchise tax. This program encodes those statutes,
    encodes the question scenario as facts, and then (correctly) finds that none of the
    provided statutes authorizes eviction for substantial property damage.
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations (deterministic predicates with clear citation)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  MD. State Personnel and Pensions Code Ann.  8-401 (2021)
  Secretary may adopt regulations (subject to Governor approval) prohibiting a State officer
  from paying wages unless:
    (1) officer has payroll authorization listing employee name, amount, services; and
    (2) head of principal unit certifies employees were lawfully employed and entitled.
*/

/* Deterministic helper: all items required in a payroll authorization list. */
statute_8_401_payroll_authorization_valid(payroll_auth(Employee, Amount, Services), Employee, Amount, Services) :- !.

/* Deterministic helper: certification element. */
statute_8_401_unit_head_certification_valid(certification(lawfully_employed(Employee, PayPeriod)),
                                            Employee, PayPeriod) :- !.

/* Deterministic rule: when payment is permitted under the regulatory prohibition scheme. */
statute_8_401_payment_permitted(GovernorApproved, RegulationAdopted,
                               payroll_payment(Officer, Employee, Amount, Services, PayPeriod),
                               PayrollAuthorization, UnitHeadCertification) :-
    GovernorApproved == yes,
    RegulationAdopted == yes,
    statute_8_401_payroll_authorization_valid(PayrollAuthorization, Employee, Amount, Services),
    statute_8_401_unit_head_certification_valid(UnitHeadCertification, Employee, PayPeriod),
    nonvar(Officer),
    !.

/* Deterministic rule: if Governor-approved regulations exist and requirements are not met, payment violates 8-401. */
statute_8_401_payment_violates(GovernorApproved, RegulationAdopted,
                              payroll_payment(Officer, Employee, Amount, Services, PayPeriod),
                              PayrollAuthorization, UnitHeadCertification) :-
    GovernorApproved == yes,
    RegulationAdopted == yes,
    \+ statute_8_401_payment_permitted(GovernorApproved, RegulationAdopted,
                                      payroll_payment(Officer, Employee, Amount, Services, PayPeriod),
                                      PayrollAuthorization, UnitHeadCertification),
    !.

/*
  MD. State Personnel and Pensions Code Ann.  8-402 (2021)
  Money paid in violation of 8-402 or regulations under 8-401 may be recovered from
  the officer who pays/authorizes payment or from the sureties of that officer's bond.
*/

/* Deterministic: recovery is allowed when there is a violation; liable parties are officer and sureties. */
statute_8_402_recovery_allowed(payment_violation(payroll_payment(Officer, _Employee, _Amount, _Services, _PayPeriod)),
                              recover_from(officer(Officer))) :- !.
statute_8_402_recovery_allowed(payment_violation(payroll_payment(Officer, _Employee, _Amount, _Services, _PayPeriod)),
                              recover_from(sureties_of_official_bond(Officer))) :- !.

/*
  MD. Tax - General Code Ann.  8-402.1 (2021) (duplicated in prompt)
  Franchise tax imposed each calendar year on each public service company engaged in transmission,
  distribution, or delivery of electricity or natural gas in the State; measured by kWh/therms delivered
  for final consumption in the State.
  Does not apply to therms delivered for final consumption by a public service company that is
  (1) a county; or (2) a municipal corporation.
*/

/* Deterministic classification predicates. */
statute_8_402_1_commodity(electricity) :- !.
statute_8_402_1_commodity(natural_gas) :- !.

statute_8_402_1_tax_exemption_entity_type(county) :- !.
statute_8_402_1_tax_exemption_entity_type(municipal_corporation) :- !.

/* Deterministic: franchise tax applies to an entity/commodity given entity type and activity, with exemption for gas by county/municipal corp. */
statute_8_402_1_franchise_tax_applies(entity(Entity, EntityType),
                                     activity(engaged_in_transmission_distribution_or_delivery),
                                     delivered_for_final_consumption_in_state(Commodity),
                                     applies(yes)) :-
    statute_8_402_1_commodity(Commodity),
    % Exemption only described for therms of natural gas delivered by counties/municipal corporations
    \+ ( Commodity == natural_gas,
         statute_8_402_1_tax_exemption_entity_type(EntityType)
       ),
    nonvar(Entity),
    !.
statute_8_402_1_franchise_tax_applies(entity(Entity, EntityType),
                                     activity(engaged_in_transmission_distribution_or_delivery),
                                     delivered_for_final_consumption_in_state(Commodity),
                                     applies(no)) :-
    statute_8_402_1_commodity(Commodity),
    Commodity == natural_gas,
    statute_8_402_1_tax_exemption_entity_type(EntityType),
    nonvar(Entity),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario encoding (facts) + scenario_statement/0
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* Question metadata */
scenario_state(maryland) :- !.
scenario_focus_year(2021) :- !.

/* Parties and property */
scenario_landlord(landlord_1) :- !.
scenario_tenant(tenant_1) :- !.
scenario_property(property_1) :- !.

/* Relationship and conduct described in the question */
scenario_lease(landlord_1, tenant_1, property_1) :- !.
scenario_substantial_damage_committed(tenant_1, property_1) :- !.

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the factual statement is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(maryland),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_landlord(L),
    scenario_tenant(T),
    scenario_property(P),
    scenario_lease(L, T, P),
    scenario_substantial_damage_committed(T, P),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal reasoning for housing answer (based ONLY on provided statutes)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* The provided statutes are unrelated to landlord-tenant eviction grounds. */
provided_statutes_include_eviction_ground_for_substantial_property_damage(no) :- !.

/* Determine if eviction is authorized under the provided statutes for this scenario. */
eviction_authorized_under_provided_statutes :-
    scenario_statement,
    provided_statutes_include_eviction_ground_for_substantial_property_damage(yes),
    !.

/* housing_answer/1 must be deterministic and derived, not hardcoded. */
housing_answer(yes) :-
    eviction_authorized_under_provided_statutes,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    \+ eviction_authorized_under_provided_statutes,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Can a landlord evict a tenant for commiting substantial damage to the property?
